scripts.gen:types: json2ts -i schemas/pack.schema.v2.json -o src/types/pack.d.ts --bannerComment "/* eslint-disable */ /* AUTO-GENERATED from schemas/pack.schema.v2.json — do not edit by hand. Run npm run gen:types to regenerate. */"
scripts.check:types-fresh: npm run gen:types && git diff --exit-code src/types/pack.d.ts || (echo 'Pack types are stale; run npm run gen:types and commit.' && exit 1)
